name: UK Rank-and-Rent Local Lead Sites
one_liner: Build and rank simple 'service + city' websites for local home-service niches, then rent the site or sell its leads to a local business.
customer: Local home-service businesses (e.g. pool cleaners, trades) that are weak at online marketing
offer: Exclusive inbound leads (form fills/calls) or monthly rental of a ranking website plus tracked phone number
how_it_makes_money: Monthly rent per site or a fee per lead; you keep ownership of the domain, site and phone number; you copy one site template across niches and cities
startup_cost: low (domain, hosting/site-builder platform, call-tracking number; amounts not stated)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (depends on SEO ranking time; probably months)
evidence: Builds sites for local home service businesses, gets leads, then asks the owner 'I've got leads for you. Do you wanna buy 'em?' and 'they usually say yes' (mDE7InaRxDA)
Per-site income was transcribed as '$303,000 per website, per month', which is almost certainly a transcription error, probably $300–3,000 (mDE7InaRxDA)
'Local service businesses are generally terrible at internet marketing' (mDE7InaRxDA)
'Not all of them are gonna bring in a bunch of leads... the more websites we build, the more money we'll make' (mDE7InaRxDA)
risks: SEO ranking takes time and is uncertain
Google algorithm and local pack changes
You need some outreach to land the first business renter
Many sites will never produce leads

name: Acquire Small Cash-Flowing Online Business
one_liner: Buy an established small website or online business from a marketplace instead of starting one from scratch.
customer: Site visitors/advertisers/affiliate partners of the acquired business (the founder is the buyer)
offer: An existing monetised website (e.g. a 13-year-old content site)
how_it_makes_money: Inherit existing profit (example: $675/month at 97% margin); price is a multiple of profit; grow it or flip it
startup_cost: medium (purchase price = profit multiple; exact asking price not stated)
evidence: pestkill.org: '13-year-old content site... $675 a month in profit... at 97% margins' (hSiRCf7aZk0)
Broker has 'over 300 sales totaling over $7 million' (hSiRCf7aZk0)
Warning: 'informational type businesses are basically dead in the water now' (hSiRCf7aZk0)
risks: AI search is cutting traffic to content sites, which the broker flags himself
Buyers often fail to run the business after purchase

name: Themed Kids' Party Furniture Rentals
one_liner: Rent themed kid-sized tables, chairs, ball pits and bounce houses for children's parties and events.
customer: Parents planning kids' parties, and event planners (including high-end/VIP clients)
offer: Themed kids' furniture and play equipment rental, delivered and set up
how_it_makes_money: Per-booking rental fees, averaging $1,000–1,500 per booking; each item pays back in about 6 rentals
startup_cost: medium (initial stock ordered from abroad: 4 styles x 20 chairs; amount not stated)
evidence: 'Covering my costs in about six rentals. Everything after that is profit' (mDNl9Z6VKxM)
A six-figure business run as a side hustle with a team while the owner keeps a full-time job (mDNl9Z6VKxM)
Event planners said they otherwise had to buy these items and then dispose of them (mDNl9Z6VKxM)
risks: Physical logistics, storage and van needed

name: Impulse-Buy 'Dumb' DTC Product on Shopify
one_liner: Sell a cheap-to-make, slightly embarrassing or meme-able single product with bold branding and viral social video.
customer: Consumers on social media making impulse purchases
offer: Simple single-SKU consumer product (e.g. toilet footstool, mouth tape)
how_it_makes_money: High-margin DTC sales via Shopify; product cost is a few cents to a few dollars
evidence: Squatty Potty: 'in 2016 alone... over 28 million dollars in revenue' (l3orInyD6Ac)
Hostage Tape: 'cost... a few cents per strip... $14 million in 2023 and over $40 million in 2024' (l3orInyD6Ac)
risks: Survivorship bias: these are outlier hits

name: AI-Built Focus/Blocker Micro-App
one_liner: Use AI coding agents to build a niche Chrome extension or Mac app, such as an inbox or website blocker with scheduled access windows, and sell it.
customer: Knowledge workers who struggle with email and distraction
offer: Chrome extension / Mac app that locks email or chosen sites outside set time windows
how_it_makes_money: One-off purchase or subscription (pricing not stated)
evidence: Weak evidence: 'We have a sellable product here. That was one prompt' — built in under an hour, but no sales shown (gmwDBNcFXFU)

name: Home Bakery to Cupcake Shop
one_liner: Start baking cupcakes and jar cakes for friends at home, then scale into a production bakery.
offer: Cupcakes, jar cakes, cakes, ice cream
how_it_makes_money: Retail product sales; grew to $300k/month without ads or borrowing
startup_cost: low to start (home kitchen), high to scale
evidence: '$300,000 a month cupcake business from their kitchen' (gWlgXpomS_Q)
'Sold 1,000 cupcakes in one hour on our first day' (gWlgXpomS_Q)
'$3.6 million a year... without spending a dime on ads' (gWlgXpomS_Q)
